note: Map frame of create3_sim's maze.sdf; the robot spawns docked at (0, 0) facing +x. Every place was checked reachable from the dock by the planner. Kept to 9 places: with "no place" that is 10 options; Laya ships no valid calibration for Choice questions with 11 or more options. The dock place carries "face": where the dock itself is (create3_spawn puts it 0.157 m ahead of the docked robot), so the robot turns to see it before docking.
